subject: Tier shift: capacity playbook sync and QBR slot request
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Sanchez <marta.sanchez@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Tier shift: capacity playbook sync and QBR slot request

Hi Marta —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per HelioHealth’s ask to shift a portion of the contract to the new "tiered throughput" pricing and to onboard a 2x capacity uplift for Q1, I want to kick off a short renewal/expansion playbook so we can align stakeholders and lock the QBR slot. High-level objectives:

- Formalize the term change and tier mapping (current annual -> proposed 18-month tiered commitment)
- Confirm required capacity (sustained throughput + burst buffer) and staffing ramp
- Surface procurement/legal timeline so we can align DocuSign and billing

Action items I recommend to start:
1) You confirm the internal Helio attendees (procurement + legal + engineering owner)
2) We run a quick capacity forecast (attached) and share cost delta for the proposed tier shift
3) Schedule a 45-min QBR to present the plan, technical impact, and launch timeline

I attached a draft mutual action plan and our capacity forecast — please review and add any missing items. Proposed QBR windows: Nov 10–12 (AM PT), Nov 16–18 (flexible). If those don't work, please propose three slots next week.

I'll loop in Laura to coordinate resourcing and Stephanie to handle the contract redlines.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Marta Sanchez <marta.sanchez@heliohealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: HelioHealth Procurement <procurement@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Tier shift: capacity playbook sync and QBR slot request

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear kickoff. Quick answers:
- I'll be the technical owner and will copy in our Head of Platform (Diego Torres) this afternoon — for now add procurement and legal (procurement@heliohealth.com, legal@heliohealth.com) to the thread.
- Nov 16 (AM PT) looks best for our execs; Nov 10 is tight.
- Procurement asked for a 2-page cost summary and an outline of any SLA changes before they commit to a term amendment.

I reviewed the attachments at a glance — looks good. Please confirm: will the burst buffer be included in the committed tier pricing or billed separately? That will affect the procurement ask.

Thanks — Marta
VP, Engineering | HelioHealth

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-11-02T10:38:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Tier shift: capacity playbook sync and QBR slot request

Thanks Karthik + Marta — looping in a short internal plan from our side so Helio sees the end-to-end path.

Proposed Redwood stakeholder roster (we'll update if you add folks from Helio):
- Karthik Iyer — exec sponsor / commercial lead
- Laura Bennett — delivery lead (I’ll own capacity forecast + staffing ramp)
- Stephanie Nguyen — contracts/legal (redline & billing cadence)
- SRE on-call (named a week prior to cutover)

Internal asks for prep (target completion by Nov 12 so we can lock DocuSign and procurement):
- Laura: finalize capacity forecast and call out sustained vs burst (ETA Nov 5)
- Stephanie: draft amendment that maps current seats to tiered throughput (ETA Nov 8)
- Karthik: confirm proposed commercial terms and priority of burst buffer (one-time vs committed)

QBR logistics — Marta suggested Nov 16 AM PT. I'll open a 45-min calendar hold for Nov 16 09:00–09:45 PT and share an internal slide deck draft (outline below). If we need a second session for procurement/legal only, propose Nov 18 10–10:30 PT.

Draft QBR agenda (internal deck):
1) Executive summary and commercial ask (Karthik)
2) Capacity forecast & technical impact (Laura + Marta)
3) SLA/ops implications and staffing ramp (Laura)
4) Procurement/contract timeline (Stephanie)
5) Next steps and M.A.P. signoff

Referenced HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7854/HH-2026-042 — I'll update the notes after we close the internal deck.

Laura
Senior CSM, Delivery | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-11-03T16:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Tier shift: capacity playbook sync and QBR slot request

Great — thanks all for the quick responses. A few quick confirmations and owners:

- Burst buffer: We recommend including a fixed burst allowance in the committed tier (one-month equivalent) and bill additional burst usage on top. Stephanie will include language in the amendment to preserve a capped overage rate.
- Nov 16 09:00–09:45 PT: calendar hold sent to listed participants. If Diego or legal need a pre-call, we can do Nov 12 10:00–10:30 PT.
- Deliverables: Laura will deliver the 2-page cost summary + capacity delta (Nov 5). Stephanie will produce the draft amendment + redline (Nov 8). I'll prepare the executive readout and send the QBR deck (Nov 13).

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7854/HH-2026-042), MAP draft attached. DocuSign plan: target signature by Nov 25 to meet an effective date of Dec 1.

If that timeline works for Helio, please reply with a short "ACK" and add any additional attendees.

Thanks — looking forward to the session.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachments: HH-2026-042_mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx, HH_Capacity_Forecast_v2.pdf
